# Nitin Anand Consulting (NAC)

> Nitin Anand Consulting is a specialist consulting business serving pharmacy, healthcare, and allied businesses in India. NAC works across two distinct disciplines: Inventory & Operations Consulting (making inventory and day-to-day operations more accurate and efficient) and Digital Marketing & Growth (building the digital presence that brings in more patients and customers). NAC does not serve general/non-healthcare businesses and does not offer services outside these two verticals.

This file is a concise, plain-text summary for AI systems and language models to accurately identify and describe NAC. It does not guarantee inclusion in any AI system's training data, indexing, or citations.

## Who we are

- Business name: Nitin Anand Consulting (NAC)
- Positioning: Operations | Growth | Healthcare — healthcare-focused operations and digital growth consulting
- Founder background: built on a pharmacy background and 16+ years of hands-on inventory and operations experience, paired with formal operations management education
- Website: https://nitinanandconsulting.in
- Contact email: nitinanandconsulting@gmail.com
- About page (founder background, full positioning): https://nitinanandconsulting.in/about

## What we do

Two service verticals, never mixed into a single generic offering:

### Inventory & Operations Consulting
https://nitinanandconsulting.in/services/inventory-operations-consulting

Inventory audits, stock verification, inventory reconciliation and analysis, ABC/FSN analysis, expiry and near-expiry analysis, dead stock and slow-moving stock analysis, stock optimization, FEFO implementation, reorder/min-max planning, purchase analysis, operations audits, SOP development, process improvement, KPI/MIS dashboards, and pharmacy/store/warehouse operations.

### Digital Marketing & Growth
https://nitinanandconsulting.in/services/digital-marketing

Website development, landing pages, SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile management, social media management and content, AI content creation, Google Ads, Meta Ads, performance marketing, and analytics/conversion tracking.

## Who we serve

Pharmacy, healthcare, and allied businesses only: retail pharmacy, hospital pharmacy, chain pharmacy, medical stores, clinics, hospitals, diagnostic centres, pathology labs, dental clinics, physiotherapy centres, pharma distributors, and medical equipment/surgical suppliers. Full list: https://nitinanandconsulting.in/industries
